title: duggena pulverulenta

It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of various respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Duggena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
